prompt:
Create a polished STATIC UI preview PNG with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background for a Windows lyrics overlay called Proyecto Reze. The image demonstrates two alternative high-contrast treatments of the SAME 'Solo letras' mode. There must be NO general window background, NO wallpaper, NO desktop, NO checkerboard pattern painted into the image, NO product title, NO toolbar, NO controls, NO cats, NO icons, NO song metadata, NO explanatory labels. Only two separate lyric strips floating in clear transparent space. This is the app's lyrics-only mode with a local backing directly behind the text, not a screenshot of the complete app.

Composition: landscape canvas around 1400x700 with generous TRANSPARENT margins and transparent gap between two centered, perfectly aligned horizontal lyric strips. Each strip is fit to its text, about 1060px wide and 110px tall on this presentation canvas, with a subtle 18px-equivalent corner radius and comfortable horizontal padding. Do not fill the entire canvas with a color. The two strips are the same size and use the same exact text: 'La música sigue aquí'. Text must be large, very crisp, semibold Segoe UI-like sans serif, center aligned, with correct Spanish accents. Render no other words. No bevel, no 3D, no glass, no elaborate glow. No drop shadow extending over a large surrounding panel.

TOP STRIP: matte solid dark gray #29292D rounded backing immediately behind the lyric. The complete text is bright white #FFFFFF. Clean readable high contrast, like an elegant subtitle overlay. A tiny restrained shadow may separate this LOCAL text plate from a desktop when composited, but its surrounding canvas is fully transparent. The white text is not a shiny gradient.

BOTTOM STRIP: inverse alternative, matte solid light gray #F1F1F4 rounded backing immediately behind the same lyric. Text near-black #202024. Same typography, same size, same padding and alignment. The light plate does NOT connect to the top plate, there is fully transparent space between them.

The output must preserve alpha transparency around both strips and in their entire gap. These are alternative visual options, not two simultaneously displayed lines in the real app. No floating captions that would become invisible on different backgrounds. The mockup should be immediately usable to show a developer what a backgroundless overlay with a localized contrast band behind lyrics should look like. Genuinely transparent cutout; no opaque white canvas.
notes: Arriba banda oscura/letra blanca; abajo alternativa clara/letra oscura. Comparación de opciones, no dos líneas simultáneas. Implementar con texto y CSS, no usar como textura de interfaz.
